8BitDo.UltimateSoftwareV2:
The newly designed 8BitDo Ultimate Software V2 is a one-stop solution for your 8BitDo devices. You can use it to configure keys, macros and a series of other professional-grade features as per preference, keep your devices up to date.

Features
- Key Mapping
  - Modify and disable certain key functions to create your own profile.
- Macros
  - Multiple complex instructions combos can be triggered with just a single keystroke.
- Firmware Update
  - Keep your devices up-to-date and in the best condition.
- Lighting
  - Adjust lighting effects and colors.

8x8.QualityManagement: Users who are subscribed to Screen Recording services for Quality Management have the ability to capture agents' desktop screens. For users that have the Screen Client software installed on the agents' machines, administrators of the system can elect to record the agents' desktop activity along with telephone conversations. After the call is completed, you can watch the video recording in the Slide out Panel.

Place and manage calls flexibly, chat with contacts, schedule and conduct productive meetings within your company or with external participants, and much more.
